args.prompt:
Create ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG KFB ink monster character sheet. EXACTLY SIX distinct CIVILIAN EMERGENCY / ACUTE / INTENSIVE MEDICAL TEAM members in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Emergency physician, paramedic, anaesthetist, trauma surgeon, intensive-care nurse, cardiologist. Quirky absurd-surreal working personalities, high-stakes concentration with human warmth, satirical but not cruel. Two female-read, no military theme.
The supplied PNGs STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first defines whole rounded dark charcoal-violet ink body, soft rich plasticine and thick modeled lids; second defines beautifully crafted clay props. NEW actors, not edits or copies.
Every actor ONE COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS continuous charcoal-black ink splat with subtle deep violet sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, huge face directly in goo, two short rounded goo hands, a few contained detached drops. NO human torso/legs/feet, severed bust, realistic human anatomy, fur or angular rock body. Shared clinic cues: one small TEAL scrub collar/shoulder fold, short IVORY coat-lapel accents where appropriate, optional small teal cap; most dark body remains visible. Paramedic alone may add orange reflective shoulder panel. No full scrub-clothed human shape. Fine sculpted plasticine, soft handmade volumes/fingerprints/seams/selective wear; weird offbeat clay cartoon, not Pixar human mascots.
ALL visible EYES WHITE/IVORY sclera enclosing small RED iris and BLACK pupil, thick fully violet-black clay eyelids. Six different facial proportions/gaze/brows/lid weights/mouths/lips. Irregular ivory teeth, no repeated angry grins or dangling tongues. Faces/mouths fully uncovered: NO masks, face shields, goggles or spectacles over face. No patients, injuries, blood, surgery scene, needle insertion, military symbols, real organization emblems, red-cross logo, text, numbers or clinical procedure diagram. Stylized simple role props, not instructional equipment schematic.

TOP LEFT — FEMALE-READ EMERGENCY PHYSICIAN. Tall broad pear blob with one hooked crown loop, tiny plain ivory hairband, short dark clay side curl and subtle lashes. Small teal collar, two short ivory coat lapels. Focused urgent resolve: one huge WHITE eye forward and other sharply squinting, one high/one low brow, shallow crooked clenched mouth with three uneven teeth, heavy lower lip. Holds ONE SIMPLE STETHOSCOPE low in one hand: two short metal ear tubes with rounded ear tips join one obvious Y-shaped black flexible tube leading to ONE round silver chest disc, no disconnected loops or impossible branches. Other hand holds ONE small plain triage CLIPBOARD with THREE bold colored edge tabs and blank cream paper, no writing. Entire device and board inside cell.
TOP MIDDLE — MALE-READ PARAMEDIC. Very wide low bean blob, three blunt crown nubs, small ORANGE RESCUE HELMET with a plain ivory HEART patch, one orange shoulder panel over a teal cloth fold, no full jacket or armor. Alarmed helpful enthusiasm: two unequal enormous WHITE eyes looking UP sideways, raised uneven inner brows, half-open crooked brave smile with two unequal teeth, tense lower lip. Both hands protect ONE compact ORANGE MEDICAL KIT CASE at belly, rounded corners, sturdy handle/two latches, one bold ivory heart emblem, no lettering or real logo. No stretcher or extra equipment pile.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ ANAESTHETIST. Round top-heavy upright dumpling with one coiled crown lobe, tiny teal scrub cap above face, short teal V-collar and ivory cuff scrap. Controlled exhausted calm: very heavy half-lidded WHITE eyes looking SIDEWAYS, gently unequal flat brows, enormous CLOSED crooked pout with one tiny lower tooth. Both hands cradle ONE simplified BLUE SELF-INFLATING RESUSCITATION BAG with a short single connector to ONE clear rounded face MASK at its end; clear coherent continuous device, bag squeezable plasticine, mask tilted LOW away from own face. Mask is a held equipment prop only, never worn. No long tubes, oxygen tank or patient.
BOTTOM LEFT — MALE-READ TRAUMA SURGEON. Broad near-square soft splat with two uneven low crown lobes, small teal scrub cap and ONE short ivory lapel with teal shoulder fold. Ferocious meticulous concentration: one WHITE eye round and other compressed while looking DOWN, asymmetrically heavy brows, CLOSED pinched crooked lip with two offset ivory teeth. Holds ONE short blunt STEEL FORCEPS with two large simple ring handles and a single pair of rounded jaws, and ONE small stack of folded IVORY GAUZE in the other hand. Both props LOW at belly, no blood, blade, wound, suturing or operating scene. Face fully uncovered.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ INTENSIVE-CARE NURSE. Tall wavy-edged soft bean blob, one small dark clay side curl, subtle lashes, plain small teal headband and shared teal/ivory shoulder accents. Tired compassionate firmness: unequal WHITE eyes look DOWN, one lid lowered and opposite brow raised thoughtfully, warm almost CLOSED asymmetric smile with one small upper tooth and a heavy lower lip. One hand holds ONE small clear IV FLUID BAG by its thick top tab, plain light-blue drop shape in bag, no labels/numbers. A SINGLE short transparent tube leads from bag bottom to one chunky teal ROLLER CLAMP held in other hand. Tube ends visibly below clamp, no needle/patient/pole, no tangled loops. Whole apparatus LOW beside body.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ CARDIOLOGIST. Tall crooked pear blob with two folded crown lobes, no hat, one tiny rumpled clay side lock, short ivory lapels over teal collar. Anxious intense attention: one enormous WHITE eye and other narrowed stare DOWN at own screen, inner brow corners high, small clenched zigzag mouth with one central tooth and deep protruding lower lip. Both hands hold ONE compact TEAL HEART MONITOR with one large dark screen showing ONE simple WHITE STYLIZED PULSE ZIGZAG, one red heart-shaped button and a thick handle. No numbers, labels, detailed readouts, long wires or bedside machine. Device chunky and comprehensible, not a sci-fi console.

COMPOSITION: six LARGE complete independent actors in regular3x2 visual grid, similar substantial body height across rows. Whole silhouettes450-465px per512pxlogical cell, clear margins/gutters especially32-40px between rows. Contain all hats/tubes/cases/bags/instruments/boards/monitor/droplets in OWN cells; no touching/overlap/cut-off details or miniature bottom row. Goo and expressive faces dominate, common teal/ivory medical theme consistent. No gridlines, background gradient, checkerboard, floor, shadows disc, halo, text or watermark. True alpha-zero transparency outside figures, opaque interiors, clean antialiased edges; soft upper-left studio lighting on figures only.
